scope: Two-pass audit of all six ordinary body-flow citation keys, their smallest nearby claims, canonical bibliography metadata, all publication inputs, and bounded post-v2 resolution searches. Primary publisher, official preprint, author-posted, and arXiv full-text passages were checked; the negative novelty search is not a priority proof.
citation_audit_method: citation-check-skill two-pass extraction followed by claim-level primary-source verification, DOI/publisher metadata comparison, exact passage location review, bibliography-key consistency checks, and bounded current-literature search; no subagents were used because the runner explicitly prohibited them
